sentences.en: Dad looks at the map.
Grandmother is in the north.
The north of their country is cold.
Dad points to the capital on the map.
sentences.fa: بابا پایتخت را روی نقشه نشان می‌دهد.

sentences.en: The capital is a big city.
The south of their country is warmer.
They are not in the south.

sentences.fa: بخش شرقی کشور از آن‌ها دور است.

sentences.en: The sun rises in the east.
The west is far, too.
They do not go west.
There is a lot of open land.

sentences.fa: این زمین برای مزرعه‌ها مناسب است.

sentences.en: They go through a town.

They go across the land.

The road goes around the town.

sentences.fa: یک پرنده بالای قطار پرواز می‌کند.

sentences.en: It stays above the train for a moment.
The sun is high in the sky.

sentences.fa: قطار از روی یک جاده می‌گذرد.

sentences.en: The land is below the train bridge.

sentences.fa: مینا بین مامان و بابا می‌نشیند.

sentences.en: She sits at the front of the train.
The driver is at the front of the train.
The back of the train is full.
Her bag is at the back of the train.
sentences.fa: کیفش در قسمت عقب قطار است.

sentences.en: The train moves away from the city.
Soon, the city is far away.
They are off again.
The train moves off.
The bird is over the train.

The sun goes down.

check.q: مینا بین مامان و چه کسی می‌نشیند؟
